abiJson.author: Amir
abiJson.description: Standard Jetton Minter. TEP-74 and TEP-89 compliant

declarations.name: ApeClaimDetails
declarations.description:
Backend-signed withdrawal entitlement. The per-wallet monotonic sequence
provides replay protection without an ever-growing dictionary in the minter.

declarations.name: CloseApeMintingForever
declarations.description: Irreversible. Admin remains available for transfer freeze and metadata.

declarations.name: WithdrawApeTreasuryTons
declarations.description:
Admin-only withdrawal of an explicit amount of accumulated TON. The
destination is deliberately fixed to the configured APE treasury.

declarations.name: ApeJettonPolicy
declarations.description:
Mutable policy is stored behind one reference so the TEP-74 root remains compact.
Closing minting is irreversible, while claim pause and transfer freeze stay reversible.

declarations.name: string_prefixed0x
declarations.description:
A string, which contents starts with 0x00/0x01 byte.
By standard, offchain explorers/APIs may treat contents of a string based on 0xXX prefixes:
- 0x00 + "str" — means "this is a regular snake-encoded string"
- 0x01 + "str" — means "this is an off-chain content URL"
Used in jettons and NFTs for responses from GET methods to comply with TEPs (token standards).
